DSH app over its s"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"tock `/api` surface (the pipe is the browser's loopback
stand-in client, because the extension's Ori"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"gin is refused by the DSH trust
fence — by design)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Components"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| path | what it is |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| `extension/` | MV3 Chrome extension: side panel chat, service worker (native port + browser execut"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"or), page veil, work-tab overlays, theme tokens |
| `pipe.mjs` | native messaging host: loopback bri"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"dge to the DSH app's `/api` surface, downlinks, plugin channel |
| `plugin/` | the `dsh-augmentor` D"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"SH plugin (npm package + git bundle): `/api/augmentor` handshake, pipe WS channel, `browser_*` tools"},{"id":"p10s5","text":", chat lifecycle |
| `wire.mjs` | the shared wire primitives (frame codec + pending table) used by a"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"ll three runtimes — one implementation, three consumers |
| `install-native-host.sh` | installs the "},{"id":"p10s7","text":"Chromium native-messaging-host manifest + the per-machine channel token |
| `test/` | e2e suites (m3"},{"id":"p10s8","text":", sw, panel, chrome, m2, tools) + `install-proof.mjs` (deterministic fresh-user install proof) + `pl"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"ugin/tests/boot/` |
| `PROPOSAL-plugin-architecture.md` | the architecture record: milestones M1–M4,"},{"id":"p10s10","text":" audit findings S/D/F, decisions |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## DSH compatibility"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Augmentor 0.1.32 targets **DSH 0.1.5-rc.1** and its authenticated Typert API.
Upgrade the plugin, na"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"tive host and extension together. Augmentor 0.1.31
and earlier do not work with this DSH release: th"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"eir SDK dependency,
HTTP method names, authentication and event streams predate the new API."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"To update an existing installation after installing this release:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Restart DSH and reload Augmentor at `chrome://extensions`. For the npm
plugin path, use `dsh plugin "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"--profile web add dsh-augmentor@0.1.32` from npm. The installer reconciles dependencies, installs
th"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"e Augmentor preset when missing, and backs up a legacy preset before
renaming its persona `text` set"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ting to `prefix`. A custom `DSH_HOME` must
be the same for DSH, the installer and the browser/native"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"o `prefix`. A custom `DSH_HOME` must
be the same for DSH, the installer and the browser/native host."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The bridge exchanges DSH's launch token through a local endpoint protected
by Augmentor's existing a"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ction-channel secret. Its session cookie remains
inside the native host. No extension cookie permiss"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ion or disabled DSH
authentication is required."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Tested on **Linux with Chromium**, Node.js 22.19+ or 24+, and DSH 0.1.5-rc.1."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"1. Install/update DSH: `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1`.
2. Download Augmentor 0.1.32 ZI"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"P and extract the entire
`augmentor-0.1.32` folder to a permanent location. It includes the plugin,
"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"extension, native host and preset. Keep all the files together.
Source alternative: `git clone --bra"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"nch v0.1.32 https://github.com/ManoloRemiddi/augmentor-dsh-extension-plugin.git`.
3. Open `chrome://"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"extensions`, enable **Developer mode**, choose **Load unpacked**,
select `extension/` in the extract"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"ed folder and copy the extension ID.
4. From the extracted folder, run `sh install-native-host.sh EX"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"TENSION_ID "$HOME/.config/chromium"`
with that ID. The second argument is the browser user-data root"},{"id":"p19s8","text":", not `Default`.
Other Linux defaults: Chrome `~/.config/google-chrome`, Edge `~/.config/microsoft-e"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"dge`,
Brave `~/.config/BraveSoftware/Brave-Browser`. Other platforms are not verified;
these shell c"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"ommands are not a Windows installer.
5. In the same folder, run `dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/"},{"id":"p19s11","text":"plugin"`.
Alternatively install `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-augmentor@0.1.32`.
Choose one meth"},{"id":"p19s12","text":"od and use your app's actual profile if different from `web`.
Pinning the npm version avoids an olde"},{"id":"p19s13","text":"r release being selected by release-age filtering.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Security posture"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **The DSH trust fence is why the pipe exists — it is not bypassed.** The
DSH app's `/api` refuses "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"requests from foreign browser origins (the
extension's `chrome-extension://` origin included, by des"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ign). `pipe.mjs`
is a loopback stand-in client: it runs locally as the user and talks to
the app ove"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"r `127.0.0.1`, which is exactly what the fence permits.
- **No new remote surface.** Every hop is lo"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"opback (extension ↔ pipe via
native messaging, pipe ↔ app via `127.0.0.1`); nothing this stack adds "},{"id":"p21s6","text":"is
reachable from other hosts. The trust boundary is the local OS user:
anything that can already re"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"ad your home directory is not blocked by this
stack (and could already do the same things directly a"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"gainst the app).
- **The action channel is secret-gated.** The `browser_*` commands flow over
a WS c"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"hannel the plugin authenticates with a per-machine token
(`$DSH_HOME/augmentor-ws-token`, 0600, crea"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"ted by the installer or first
boot; a configured `actionToken` wins). The pipe presents it in the WS"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"
handshake header and the plugin compares it in constant time; a local
process without that file can"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"not drive your browser.
- **The in-panel "Trust-fence probe"** (≣ Sessions → *Probe*) is a diagnosti"},{"id":"p21s13","text":"c
that shows the fence working as designed (extension-origin requests
refused, loopback requests acc"},{"id":"p21s14","text":"epted). It probes; it does not bypass."}],"truncated":true}
